# Nimbus

Generated by NeuroGenUI from a sketch and voice instructions (version ).

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

- `src/pages/` one component per page, `src/components/` reusable UI components,
- `src/runtime/actions.js` the event actions (validation, messages, navigation),
- `src/runtime/store.js` the UI state (current page, field values, messages).

import { useUI } from "../runtime/store.js";
import { runActions } from "../runtime/actions.js";
import Button from "../components/Button.jsx";
import Card from "../components/Card.jsx";
import Container from "../components/Container.jsx";
import Divider from "../components/Divider.jsx";
import Heading from "../components/Heading.jsx";
import Icon from "../components/Icon.jsx";
import Image from "../components/Image.jsx";
import Message from "../components/Message.jsx";
import NavItem from "../components/NavItem.jsx";
import Navbar from "../components/Navbar.jsx";
import Page from "../components/Page.jsx";
import Text from "../components/Text.jsx";

const BTN_TRY_FREE_CLICK = [
  {
    "type": "navigate",
    "page": "page_sign_up"
  }
];

export default function MainPage() {
  const ui = useUI();
  const handleBtnTryFreeClick = () => runActions("btn_try_free", BTN_TRY_FREE_CLICK, ui);

  return (
    <Page id="page_main">
      <Container id="box_1" layout={{ direction: "row", align: "center" }}>
        <Text id="txt_nimbus" label="Nimbus" />
        <Text id="txt_features" label="Features" />
        <Text id="txt_about" label="About" style={{ textAlign: "center", alignSelf: "center" }} />
      </Container>
      <Navbar
        id="nav_main_navbar"
        layout={{ direction: "row", align: "center", justify: "between" }}
      >
        <Text id="txt_cloud_storage_made" label="Cloud storage made simple" />
        <Text
          id="txt_features_2"
          label="Features"
          style={{ textAlign: "center", alignSelf: "center" }}
        />
        <Text id="txt_pricing" label="Pricing" />
        <NavItem id="navi_features" label="Features" />
        <NavItem id="navi_pricing" label="Pricing" />
        <NavItem id="navi_about" label="About" />
        <Button id="btn_get_started" label="Get started" />
      </Navbar>
      <Container id="box_hero_section">
      </Container>
      <Container id="box_9" layout={{ direction: "row", align: "center" }}>
        <Button id="btn_try_free" label="Try free" onClick={handleBtnTryFreeClick} />
        <Message owner="btn_try_free" />
        <Icon id="ico_c" label="C" />
        <Divider id="div_12" />
        <Divider id="div_13" />
        <Divider id="div_14" />
        <Heading id="h_cloud_storage_made" label="Cloud storage made simple" level={1} />
        <Divider id="div_16" />
        <Text id="txt_17" />
        <Divider id="div_18" />
        <Button id="btn_learn_more" label="Learn more" variant="secondary" />
        <Image
          id="img_hero_image"
          photo="banner"
          alt="Hero image"
          style={{ height: 345, alignSelf: "flex-end" }}
        />
      </Container>
      <Container id="box_21" layout={{ direction: "row", align: "center" }}>
        <Card id="card_fast" layout={{ gap: 26 }}>
          <Text id="txt_fast" label="Fast" />
          <Icon id="ico_24" />
          <Text id="txt_fast_2" label="Fast" />
          <Divider id="div_26" />
          <Divider id="div_27" />
        </Card>
        <Container id="box_feature_cards" layout={{ gap: 29 }}>
          <Text id="txt_secure" label="Secure" />
          <Heading id="h_30" level={2} />
          <Text id="txt_paragraph" label="Paragraph" />
          <Container id="box_32" layout={{ direction: "row", align: "center" }}>
            <Text id="txt_33" />
            <Divider id="div_34" />
          </Container>
          <Text id="txt_35" />
          <Card id="card_secure">
          </Card>
        </Container>
        <Card id="card_synced" layout={{ gap: 20 }}>
          <Text id="txt_synced" label="Synced" />
          <Icon id="ico_38" />
          <Text id="txt_synced_2" label="Synced" />
          <Divider id="div_40" />
          <Divider id="div_41" />
        </Card>
      </Container>
    </Page>
  );
}
